purpose: Source-bound adaptive exact-quota propensity correction, charged public lookahead, finite state and ordinary-cost comparison.
tape: Same public affine ordering (73*t+19) mod 248, ordered p then a; no truth used in construction.
checks: Exact one checked receipt per block; predicted probability precedes receipt.
Allocation weights frozen; buffer advice computed before selector; label feedback only at block end.
Ticket multiplicity equals selected probability; normalization preserves mass.
Source hashes, actual invoices and development traces retained before evaluator labels.
Each bound retains finite state/action allowances; realized selector fees not substituted for unconditional expectation.
comparisons: Existing same-tape uniform fixed-state arms and cold direct/table/cache controls; no paired action-path or causal accuracy claim across different bit schedules.
